Dr. Glory Swarupa Sunchu born in the year 1969 in Warangal, Telangana has spent over twenty-five years in entrepreneurship. Her career spans collaborations with institutions under various Union Ministries, including Commerce & Industry; Environment, Forest & Climate Change; Education; Fisheries; Micro Small & Medium Enterprises; and Bhartiya Skill Development University. She has promoted various Agro-Rural clusters nationwide, encompassing handlooms, handicrafts, natural fibres, toys, honey, coconut, millets, jackfruit, and banana, among others. In line with National Priorities and the UN Sustainable Development Goals, she is pursuing the concept of Doubling Women Entrepreneurs and establishing Centres of Excellence in Clean Technologies and Future/Smart Technologies. As the first Woman Director General, she manages a self-financed National Institution.
Current designation
Director General at National Institute of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (ni-msme), Government of India.
Education
* Ph.D. from First Bhartiya Skill Development University in India in the area of Entrepreneurship & Skill Development.
* M.Sc Chemistry from National Institute of Technology, Warangal.
Alumnus
National Institute of Technology (NIT), Warangal.
Publications
She has penned nine books, published 51 scientific papers, and created five films, while managing several research projects. Additionally, she has presented papers at numerous international conferences. Her significant work in building the capacity of professionals and promoting entrepreneurship in higher education institutions is commendable. Her leadership is vital in informing developing countries about best practices in the Indian MSME sector through international training programs, earning her global acclaim.
Membership
* Steering Committee Member for DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Govt. of India
* Ministerial Task Force (MTF) Committee for Futuristic Initiatives on Innovation
* MSME & Start-up Promotion Board of ICMAI
* Sector Skill Councils
* Board of Studies of Skill University and University of Knowledge & Technology
* Executive Committee of Centre for Entrepreneurship Development
* Start-up Policy Formulation Committee of NIT, Raipur
* Global Council of World Agriculture Forum
* Steering Committee for the Directorate of Entrepreneurship and Innovation, SRM University, Andhra Pradesh
* Member of Working Group for the Sub-theme MSME and Informal Employment - Urban, under the theme of 'Promoting Entrepreneurship, Employment & Skilling - Leveraging the Demographic Dividend of Ministry of MSME
* Committee Member at International Society for Data Sciences and Innovation-Global, IIM Nagpur
* ET MSME Regional Summit: Hyderabad edition to spotlight strategies for empowering Telangana's MSME ecosystem for growth and innovation
* Speaker at Confederation of Indian Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
* Dignitary in the two-day The Hans India National Education Policy conference
Awards and Honors
* 2024: Distinguished Alumnus Award (DAA) – 2024 by the National Institute of Technology, Warangal for outstanding contributions in the category of Professional Excellence (Industry/Corporate)
* 2023: Smt. Vedmati memorial eminence award in education, united nations sustainable development goals award for outstanding contributions in Gender Equality.
* 2023: Lifetime Achievement Award in recognition of her unparalleled contributions towards overall development of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises in India.
* 2022: Telangana's Women Leaders in MSME Sector
* 2022: Dr. Kamala Bhagwat Sohonie Science Shikshika Shodhkartri Mention
* 2021: Best Learning & Development Training Professional at Agri Awards
* 2018: Excellence in Education in the 7th Principals & Teachers Award
